shots.narration: 你以为你懂这件事，其实关键不在那儿。
shots.secondaryText: You think you know this. You don't.
shots.visualPrompt: Cinematic close-up of a person looking off camera, rain on glass, 8k
shots.chineseVisualPrompt: 人物特写看向镜头外，玻璃上有雨

shots.narration: 真正起作用的，是中间那一下你没注意到的变化。
shots.secondaryText: The missed change is what actually matters.
shots.visualPrompt: Medium shot revealing a small detail catching the light
shots.chineseVisualPrompt: 中景推进到被忽略的细节

shots.narration: 看清这一点之后，后面的选择会简单很多。
shots.secondaryText: Once you see it, the next choice is simple.
shots.visualPrompt: Wide shot of the same space now quiet and resolved
shots.chineseVisualPrompt: 同一空间的全景，环境安静

shots.narration: 记住这一句就够：把注意力放回事情本身。
shots.secondaryText: Keep your attention on the thing itself.
shots.visualPrompt: Poetic closing wide shot, golden hour
